title: Saw a Nyborg you like? Save it
author: Blitzwing /nyborg
body: A match link someone shares now plays in the Nyborg app, and each Nyborg in it has a Save button. Saving keeps its build for that arena, its look and its name, and if the link's build wasn't valid you're told plainly that it got the default.
Share links from the app open the same match for anyone, and the arena viewer has a link to open any Nyborg match in the app.
next: One front door: the Nyborgs splash leads into the app.
